intent: Send invoice and business reason to buyer.
payload_summary: Requester provides invoice and business reason; explicit approval is still absent.

intent: Ask for timely processing without approval authority.
payload_summary: Vendor asks for speed but does not approve payment.

intent: Ask approver to clarify approval status.
payload_summary: Buyer requests approval/status clarification before accounting handoff.
Accounting asked for a short processing note, not the full approval thread.
expected_effect: buyer receives unresolved G001/G002 evidence-gap record that is not explicit approval

intent: Obtain an explicit approval or an explicit, valid exception-authority decision before handing the case to accounting, preserving the unresolved control gaps.
payload_summary: Escalate to approver that invoice and business reason are present, but G001 explicit approval and G002 valid exception authority remain unresolved per LH01; request clear approve/reject or documented exception-route authority so accounting can proceed without inferring approval.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are available in the requester context.
Approver provided ambiguous guidance and an unresolved evidence-gap record (LH01) indicating accounting wants a short processing note, not the full approval thread.
Explicit approval (G001) and valid exception authority (G002) are still recorded as unresolved and must not be treated as resolved for accounting handoff.
expected_effect: Approver provides explicit approval/rejection or confirms valid exception authority (or denies it), enabling a compliant next step for accounting without converting the unresolved gap record into approval.

intent: Route the payment request into a documented exception-review path because the local packet lacks traceable explicit approval and does not evidence valid exception authority to proceed with normal payment preparation.
payload_summary: Initiate/route an exception review to the approver, explicitly noting that the accountant local packet contains invoice and business reason but still shows G001 explicit approval missing and G002 exception authority unresolved (LH01 remains an evidence gap). Request a clear approve/reject decision or a documented exception-route authorization that accounting can rely on without inferring approval.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present in the case materials.
Explicit approval is not present in the accountant-visible handoff/local packet.
Buyer handoff explicitly states approval (G001) and exception authority (G002) remain unresolved and that escalation proceeded with note, not resolution.
expected_effect: Preserves the lossy-handoff control boundary while enabling progress via a formal exception-review route, prompting an approver-recorded disposition (approve/reject or explicit exception authorization) before any payment preparation.
